exposure: Timing of cesarean delivery (emergency before labor, during labor after induction of labor)
Social support in the operating room
outcome: Postpartum depression (provisional diagnosis via EPDS score)
cohort: Women undergoing cesarean delivery before or during labor at 34 or more weeks of gestation, enrolled from 27 French hospitals.
finding: Around one in six women had postpartum depression symptoms 2 months after cesarean delivery, with risk factors including younger age, non-European country of birth, specific cesarean contexts (emergency before labor, during labor after induction), severe postoperative pain, and bad memories of delivery.
mod_finding: Certain cesarean-related obstetric factors, such as emergency cesareans before labor or cesareans during labor after induction, were identified as increasing the risk of postpartum depression.
